The prosecution case, in short, is that on 20th of April, 1974 corresponding to 6th Baisakh, 1381 BS at about 6-30 A M the accused appellants along with others (since acquitted) being armed with fire arms and other deadly weapons trespassed into the land of RS Plot No. 306 appertaining to RS Khatian No. 7/1 of Mouza Nonachari, PS Moheshkhali, Cox's Bazar and in prosecution of the common object of such assembly, committed the offence of rioting with fire arms and other weapons of offence and cut away the paddy from the said plot wrongfully and dishonestly despite protest of the informant PW 1 Asad Ali specific allegations against appellant No. 1 Ali Ahmed is to the effect that he opened fire on getting order from accused Appellant No. 2 Hail Asad Ali causing multiple bullet injuries on the person of victim Nur Ahmed and that be did the act with intention or knowledge of causing his death and such death was attempted to be caused and that it was done with the intention of causing such bodily injury as he knew to be likely to cause the death of Nur Ahmed and thus committed an offence under section 307 of the Penal Code. 

 6. The Informant PW 1 Asad Ali is full brother of the victim. He has stated that the occurrence took place on RS Plot No. 306 of Mouza Nonachari on 6th of Baisakh, 1381 BS at about 6-30 AM corresponding to 20th April, 1974. The area of RS Plot No.306 will be about 9.20 acres. His cousin brother Nur Ahmed purchased a portion of the said RS Plot No.306 in 1965 by registered kabala marked Exhibit I and his brothers Nazir Ahmed and Jalal Ahmed purchased some plots of land measuring .40 decimals from the said RS Plot No. 306 in 1972 from Banamali by kabala Exhibit 1/1. The informant himself and his brothers Jalal Ahmed and Nazir Ahmed alto purchased some other plots from the said RS plot No. 306 in 1974 by registered kabala. The original kabala of this purchase was not received. But there was a deed of agreement and it is marked Exhibit 2. Thereafter the informant and his brothers acquired ownership of all the plots comprising the RS Plot No.305 within RS Khatian No. 7/1 of Mouza Nonachari and continued to possess same. PW 1 has further stated that he and his two brothers also possessed the land of his said cousin Nur Ahmed as his bargadars. On she date of occurrence at about 6-30 AM he found that some people were cutting away paddy from his plot of the land and he called his brothers Nazir Ahmed and Jalal Ahmed and PW3 Nur Ahmed and his neighbour PW4 Ijjat Ali and others. Then they along with PW 5 Golam Kader ran towards their land and found the appellants along with other accused. The appellant Ali Ahmed had a gun in his hand. The appellants Lal Meah and accused Zebal Hossain, Nur Ahmed and Fazal Karim were carrying rifles in their hands. The appellant Shafiur Rahman alias Safir Ahmed had a ram dao in his hand. Other accused persons were armed with rifles Hucha and Kachi. They found the accused persons to have already reaped ripe Boro paddy from half of the RS plot No.306. The informant party having challenged the accused appellant Haji Asad Ali ordered appellant Ali Ahmed and others to finish them with fire arms and thereupon the appellant Ali Ahmed and accused Lal Meah Sikder opened fire with their arms at them. They retreated and jumped into the streamlet when victim Nur Ahmed cried saying "mother Ali Ahmed has finished me." Nur Ahmed was in an unconscious state. The bullets hit his hand, leg and back and blood was profusely cozing out. PW 3 Nur Ahmed came to Moheshkhali Hospital at about 9-00 AM in a launch after covering a distance of 7/8 miles. He was admitted in the hospital and thereafter FIR was lodged with the Moheshkhali Police Station. It is also in the evidence of PW 1 that the investigating Officer visited the place of occurrence, seized the alamats and examined the witnesses under section 161 of the Code of Criminal Procedure. In cross-examination PW 1 has said that appellant Ali Ahmed shot at PW 3 Nur Ahmed from a distance of 40/50 cubits, that he preferred an appeal against the ex-parte order passed in Miscellaneous Case Nos. 195/71 and J96/71 of the Court of Munsif, Cox's Bazar. It was suggested to PW 1 that, his brother victim Nur Ahmed was living at Dholghata with his family and that there was no occurrence at the place and in the manner as alleged in the FIR. It was further suggested to this witness that he manufactured the story of gun shot injury of his brother Nur Ahmed in the case.
